title: Bakit Lahat ng Gwapo may Boyfriend?
description: Kylie, a wedding planner, has had a long string of boyfriends who all turn out to be gay. Later, she decides to test her luck with another boy for one last time.

title: Silaw
description: A group of six teenagers go camping on a mountain. To their horror, they find a missile planted by a discharged ex-general who demands an acquittal. A team of Navy Seals are sent to save the kids and abort the madman's plan of a nuclear disaster.

title: Tatlong Anak Isang Ama
description: A musician and his three sons use music to tackle sadness and hardships in their lives.

title: Ipagpatawad Mo
description: Mike and Celina's marriage is strained after Mike fails to accept and care for their firstborn child with autism.

title: Kahit Ang Mundo Ay Magunaw
description: Amanda, a popular rich designer and Delyo, a young, romantic and charismatic singer, meet and try to build a bridge and heal the wounds of their past.

title: Andrea Paano Ba Ang Maging Isang Ina
description: Andrea asks Joyce to take care of her son before the military arrests her. Years later, Joyce believes that Andrea is dead, but Andrea appears and demands to take her son back.

title: Basagan Ng Mukha
description: Lifelong friends, one a boxer, the other an agent, find their bond tested when one is offered a huge payoff to throw a championship match.

title: Mahal Kita, Alam Mo Ba
description: A man disguises himself as an Arab to escape from police at an airport. To his luck, a girl is waiting for an Arab prince she is supposed to marry. She thinks that he is the prince and takes him home to meet her parents.

title: Masamang Ugat
description: Separated as children, two brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the law as adults, with one working as a cop trying to take down the drug lord for whom his brother works.

title: Hari ng Stunt
description: An action movie directed by Carlo J. Caparas, featuring Dante Varona.

title: Ang Pambansang Third Wheel
description: Trina experiences continuous heartbreak on her quest to find the right lover. She then dates Neo, her colleague, but discovers that he is a father to a young boy.

title: Mang Kepweng Returns
description: Mang Kepweng dies and his old nemesis, Ingkong Kapiz, returns to spread darkness in the world. Kiefer, his son and the heir to the magical bandana, attempts to save the world from Ingkong.

title: The Fighting Chefs
description: Two rival chefs and their restaurants receive a shutdown notice and have only three months to survive before their landlord sells the land to a condominium developer.

title: Magkapatid
description: A tragic incident tears apart the close bond of sisters Lisa and Cita. However, they decide to mend their relationship when their support system starts failing.

title: Andrew Ford Medina
description: Andrew Medina, a worker, meets his favorite rap artist, MC Gilbert. However, when Gilbert steals Andrew's work, the latter challenges his idol to a rap competition.

title: Bridesmaids
description: Four women from the glamorous world of fashion come together at the wedding of a common friend. Two of them are upcoming models. The third friend is a magazine editor, involved with a married man and the fourth, the daughter of a fashion designer.
